description: After accepting T3 0.1.7, the status line still reads 'T3 0.1.7 · qualified 0.1.5, 0.1.6' (flag #49). No surface shows that this controller now accepts 0.1.7, so Maya cannot confirm the decision took effect or see which versions she has accepted.
expected: 'T3 0.1.7 (accepted by you on 11/9) · qualified 0.1.5, 0.1.6', or an 'Accepted versions' line.
actual: The status is unchanged after acceptance.
suggested_fix: Render the snapshot's acceptedVersions in the status line, marking the running version as accepted.

description: Releasing a version hold without the checkbox shows 'Accepting T3 0.1.7 is a separate decision; release with acceptVersion after requalifying it'. That names the API field instead of the visible checkbox. The hold's 'requalify it before dispatch' never explains how to requalify.
expected: 'Tick "Accept this T3 version" to continue with 0.1.7', with the checkbox placed above the evidence field and visually tied to the hold.
actual: API jargon, shown off-screen for about 2 s.
suggested_fix: Rewrite the error, disable Release until the box is ticked when a version hold exists, and link 'requalify' to docs.

description: 'Queued in Pardner' is drawn in green (the success/fresh colour) even while the follow-up is blocked by a version hold, cancellation hold or foreign-run hold.
expected: A neutral or amber state when queued work is held.
actual: A green state label on blocked work.
suggested_fix: Colour queued rows by whether the session has holds, for example 'Queued · held'.
